# eccodes is the Python interface. It needs the ecCodes C library, which on
# Linux comes from the eccodeslib wheel (manylinux_2_28 x86_64), which in turn
# needs eckitlib. Both wheels exist on PyPI for CPython 3.12 on Linux.
